# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Overview

This repository contains multi-language SDK clients for the **INFO-Subscription API**, generated via [Microsoft Kiota](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openapi/kiota/) from the OpenAPI spec at `https://api.info-subscription.com/swagger/latest/swagger.json`.

Active SDKs: **.NET**, **TypeScript**, **Python**, and **PHP**.

## Build Commands

Working directory for .NET commands: `dotnet-sdk/`

```sh
dotnet build                                    # build the solution
dotnet pack --configuration Release             # create NuGet package
dotnet run --project Sample/Sample.csproj       # run the sample app
```

Working directory for TypeScript commands: `typescript-sdk/`

```sh
npm install   # install dependencies
npm run build # compile (tsc → dist/)
npm run clean # remove dist/
```

Working directory for Python commands: `python-sdk/`

```sh
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e .                     # install in editable mode
python -m build                      # build wheel + sdist
```

Working directory for PHP commands: repository root (package manifest is root-level)

```sh
composer install
composer lint
composer test
composer archive --format=zip --dir=php-package
```

The PHP suite lives in `php-sdk/tests/`. The release workflow also validates the Composer package,
runs lint/tests, and verifies the archive contains `composer.json` and `php-sdk/src/`.

## Architecture

```
dotnet-sdk/
  src/
    generated/                              # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
      kiota-lock.json                       # Kiota generation state; updated by the pipeline
    ClientConfiguration.cs                  # DI extension methods (AddInfoSubscription)
    ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider.cs
    InfoSubscriptionClientFactory.cs
    InfoSubscriptionSettingsOptions.cs
  Sample/                                   # Console app demonstrating SDK usage

typescript-sdk/
  src/
    generated/                              # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
    infoSubscriptionSettings.ts             # Settings interface
    confidentialClientAuthenticationProvider.ts  # MSAL Node B2C token provider
    tenantHeaderMiddleware.ts               # Injects S4-TenantId on every request
    infoSubscriptionClientFactory.ts        # createInfoSubscriptionClient() factory
    index.ts                                # Public API barrel export
  package.json
  tsconfig.json

python-sdk/
  src/
    info_subscription_sdk/
      generated/                            # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
      info_subscription_settings.py         # InfoSubscriptionSettings / B2CAuthSettings dataclasses
      confidential_client_authentication_provider.py  # MSAL Python B2C token provider
      tenant_header_middleware.py           # Injects S4-TenantId on every request
      info_subscription_client_factory.py   # create_info_subscription_client() factory
      __init__.py                           # Public API exports
  pyproject.toml

php-sdk/
  src/
    generated/                              # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
    B2CAuthSettings.php
    ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider.php
    InfoSubscriptionClientFactory.php
    InfoSubscriptionSettings.php
    TenantHeaderMiddleware.php
  tests/                                    # PHPUnit tests
  Sample/                                   # Read-only CLI sample using environment variables
  README.md
composer.json                               # Composer package metadata and autoload mappings

eng/
  azure-pipeline.yml    # ADO pipeline: regenerates all SDKs from the latest OpenAPI spec
  package-nuget.yml     # ADO pipeline: packs and publishes the .NET NuGet package
  package-npm.yml       # ADO pipeline: packs and publishes the TypeScript npm package
  package-python.yml    # ADO pipeline: packs and publishes the Python PyPI package
```

## Key Conventions

### Generated code is off-limits
`dotnet-sdk/src/generated/`, `typescript-sdk/src/generated/`, `python-sdk/src/info_subscription_sdk/generated/`, and `php-sdk/src/generated/` are all regenerated by the `azure-pipeline.yml` CI pipeline. Never edit these files manually. To expose additional API endpoints, add `--include-path` patterns to the `kiota generate` commands in the pipeline (and update the corresponding `kiota-lock.json`).

### .NET — DI registration
Two registration paths:
- `services.AddInfoSubscription(configuration)` — registers both the client and Azure AD B2C auth in one call.
- `services.AddClientFactory(configuration)` + `services.AddApiAuthentication(configuration)` — register separately to swap out one part.

### .NET — Configuration sections
| Section | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `InfoSubscription:ApiEndpoint` | Base URL (default: `https://api.info-subscription.com`) |
| `InfoSubscription:TenantId` | Tenant GUID sent as `S4-TenantId` request header |
| `Adb2cSettings:ClientId` | Azure AD B2C app client ID |
| `Adb2cSettings:B2CTenantName` | Azure AD B2C tenant name |
| `Adb2cSettings:ClientSecret` | Client secret for M2M auth |
| `Adb2cSettings:SignInPolicy` | B2C sign-in policy (default: `B2C_1A_V2SIGNIN`) |
| `Adb2cSettings:ScopeName` | API scope name (default: `api`) |

### .NET — HTTP resilience
Polly is wired in automatically (5 retries on transient HTTP errors) via `AddTransientHttpErrorPolicy`. Do not add additional retry logic in consuming code.

### TypeScript — Client creation
No DI framework. Use the `createInfoSubscriptionClient(settings)` factory function from `src/index.ts`. It wires up MSAL Node (B2C M2M), the `TenantHeaderMiddleware`, and Kiota's `FetchRequestAdapter` internally.

### TypeScript — Authentication pattern
- `ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider` implements Kiota's `AccessTokenProvider` using `@azure/msal-node`'s `ConfidentialClientApplication` — mirrors the .NET class exactly.
- `TenantHeaderMiddleware` implements Kiota's `Middleware` interface and injects the `S4-TenantId` header at the front of the middleware chain before the default Kiota handlers.
- The generated TypeScript client entry point is `createInfoSubscription(requestAdapter)` in `src/generated/infoSubscription.ts` (a factory function, not a class).

### Python — Client creation
Use the `create_info_subscription_client(settings)` factory function from the `info_subscription_sdk` package. Pass an `InfoSubscriptionSettings` dataclass with a nested `B2CAuthSettings`. The client is async — all request methods are `await`able.

### Python — Authentication pattern
- `ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider` implements Kiota's `AccessTokenProvider` using `msal.ConfidentialClientApplication`. Token acquisition is synchronous (MSAL handles the in-memory cache).
- `TenantHeaderMiddleware` extends `kiota_http.middleware.BaseMiddleware` (httpx-based) and injects `S4-TenantId` before the standard Kiota middleware chain.
- The generated Python client entry point is `InfoSubscription(adapter)` in `generated/info_subscription.py` (a class, not a factory).

### PHP — Client creation and authentication
- Install the Packagist package with `composer require infosoftas/info-subscription-php`.
- Use `InfoSubscriptionClientFactory::create(InfoSubscriptionSettings)` with nested `B2CAuthSettings`; requests are synchronous Kiota/Guzzle calls, e.g. `->get()->wait()`.
- `B2CAuthSettings` defaults: B2C tenant `prodlogins4`, policy `B2C_1A_V2SIGNIN`, scope `api`. `InfoSubscriptionSettings` defaults API endpoint to `https://api.info-subscription.com` and sets `S4-TenantId` middleware.
- The read-only Docker sample is documented in `php-sdk/Sample/README.md`; provide credentials through `.env` and never commit real values.
- From the repo root, copy `php-sdk/Sample/.env.example` to `php-sdk/Sample/.env` with `Copy-Item php-sdk/Sample/.env.example php-sdk/Sample/.env`, set `TENANT_ID`, `CLIENT_ID`, and `CLIENT_SECRET`, then run `docker compose -f php-sdk/compose.yml run --rm sample php index.php`.

### Versioning and releasing
[MinVer](https://github.com/adamralph/minver) (.NET), `npm version` (TypeScript), `sed` on `pyproject.toml` (Python), and the root Composer package (PHP) share git-tag versioning. All SDKs share numeric CalVer (`YYYY.M.MICRO`); a single tag triggers all GitHub Actions release workflows.

`package-nuget.yml`: **Pack → Deploy (NuGet.org + GitHub Release)**

`package-npm.yml`: **Pack → Deploy (npmjs.org)**

`package-python.yml`: **Pack → Deploy (PyPI)**

`package-php.yml`: **Validate and Pack → Attach Composer ZIP to shared GitHub Release**. Packagist
indexes tags automatically through its configured GitHub webhook; PHP has no workflow publishing
secret.

**Internal feed publishing** is handled by `azure-pipeline.yml` — preview packages (`0.0.0-preview{today}{BuildId}` NuGet, `0.0.0-preview.{today}{BuildId}` npm, `0.0.0.dev{today}{BuildId}` Python, where `{today}` is the `yyyyMMdd` pipeline run date) are pushed to `S4/Internal` automatically whenever API changes are detected (i.e., a PR is also created). PHP is not published to an internal preview feed. No internal stages in the release workflows.

See `RELEASE.md` for the full process and required GitHub configuration: `PYPI_TOKEN` for PyPI,
`RELEASE_BOT_APP_ID` and `RELEASE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` for the tag bot, and the configured
NuGet/npm trusted publishers. PHP requires no Packagist token in GitHub; one-time Packagist
registration and webhook setup are operator-managed. GitHub Releases use the built-in token.
Internal feeds (`S4/Internal`) authenticate via the build agent identity.

### Target framework (.NET)
`net10.0` — see `dotnet-sdk/global.json` for the pinned SDK version.

## Kiota `--include-path` pattern behaviour

### Segment-based prefix matching (not string prefix)

A pattern such as `/subscription` matches **all paths whose first URL segment is `subscription`** — not all paths whose string representation starts with the characters "subscription". Concretely:

| Pattern         | Matched                                                               | NOT matched                                |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `/subscription` | `/subscription`, `/subscription/{id}`, `/subscription/{id}/contact`  | `/subscriptionplan`                        |
| `/invoice`      | `/invoice`, `/invoice/{id}`, `/invoice/{id}/file`                    | `/invoiceexport/…`, `/invoiceidentifier/…` |
| `/package`      | `/package`, `/package/{id}`, `/package/{id}/validate`                | `/packagechain`, `/packagerule`            |

The bare segment pattern already covers the full sub-tree — **no wildcard is required** to include by-ID routes and nested sub-resources.

### Why `/order` AND `/order/**` both appear

Both `/order` and `/order/**` exist in the lock files and pipeline. Based on observed behaviour, the bare `/order` alone is sufficient (same segment-prefix rule as above), so the `/**` sibling is **redundant but harmless** — added defensively. Other resources (`/product`, `/package`, `/subscriber`, `/subscription`) rely on the bare pattern alone and generate sub-resource code correctly.

**Safe convention:** use **both** `/resource` and `/resource/**` when adding a new resource, matching the established `/order` + `/order/**` style. This guards against any future Kiota version tightening the bare pattern to an exact-match only.

### Adding new API paths

1. Add both `--include-path /newresource` and `--include-path /newresource/**` to the `kiotaIncludePaths` variable in `eng/azure-pipeline.yml` — that variable is shared by all SDK generation stages (C#, TypeScript, Python, PHP).
2. Add the same two patterns to `includePatterns` in each `kiota-lock.json`:
   - `dotnet-sdk/src/generated/kiota-lock.json`
   - `typescript-sdk/src/generated/kiota-lock.json`
   - `python-sdk/src/info_subscription_sdk/generated/kiota-lock.json`
   - `php-sdk/src/generated/kiota-lock.json`
3. The `descriptionHash` in those files will be refreshed automatically on the next pipeline run; do not compute it manually.
